spec_match.rationale: Covers the spec's off-happy-path contracts: unclamped out-of-range components, none channels, invalid two-component grammar, RCS conversion, and serialization.

interactive.rationale: Run-the-probes button builds a live 7-row parse/render/serialization table; three source-colour buttons run the matrix-checked conversion; both fallback cards read their own computed winner back.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises edge probes, matrix cross-check and the @supports pattern; all three sections deliver.

edge_cases.rationale: This page IS the edge-case angle; on pre-144 engines the 0/7 parse table plus working @supports fallback is explicitly framed as the demo, not a failure.

references.rationale: ChromeStatus and color-function spec links present.

conformance.rationale: Suite mirrors the same contracts (out-of-range parses, two-component rejected, RCS target space, round-trip serialization).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 (pre-144 engine) via CDP/puppeteer: every control driven at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch; full-page screenshots read; console clean except a sandbox-blocked external Google Fonts fetch (net::ERR_CONNECTION_RESET, environment egress proxy, not the demo); zero same-origin failures; zero horizontal overflow. Probes table rendered 7 honest 'no' rows on 141; @supports card computed the display-p3 fallback and said so; JS-detect card matched.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts two-component-invalid and out-of-range-parses on supported engines, matrix agreement on conversion, supports-branch consistency, and the explicit fallback branch.

design_system.rationale: Variables for UI; table scrolls in its own container; literal color() values are the feature under test.

accessibility.rationale: Real table with caption and column headers, aria-live summary and matrix readouts, 44px buttons.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Zero overflow both classes; edge table scrolls horizontally inside .table-scroller on narrow viewports.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify the supported path on Chrome 144+
openQuestions.detail: Verification ran on Chromium 141, which predates the feature, so only the unsupported/fallback branch could be exercised in-browser (it behaved correctly and honestly). When a 144+ Chrome/Canary is available, re-run the page: the support badge must flip, chips/bars must render in display-p3-linear, and the RCS cross-checks must report agreement within tolerance.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive demo layout without horizontal overflow mobile touch targets
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Design tokens/variables, >=44px touch targets, visible focus, :not()-style intent selectors, gradients/color-mix guidance.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All chrome UI colours use public/styles.css variables; range inputs and buttons have min-height 44px; native controls keep default focus rings; wide content scrolls in its own overflow-x container.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use intrinsic sizing (minmax(min(Npx,100%),1fr)) grids instead of fixed columns so panels reflow on narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Swatch pairs, converter panel, mix grid and supports cards all use repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(...,100%),1fr)); dl uses max-content/minmax(0,1fr) after a squeezed-column bug was caught on the desktop screenshot and fixed.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: puppeteer probe: documentElement.scrollWidth - clientWidth == 0 at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800 on all four concepts

guidanceConsulted.query: interactive color space demo slider controls accessible live readout
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Label every control, expose state changes through text/live regions, keep keyboard operability with native elements.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Sliders are native inputs wrapped in labels with output elements; verdict/readout containers use role=status aria-live=polite; grey ladder exposes a role=img description; tab order verified (crumbs -> sliders) and ArrowRight moves the slider and updates the readout.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP keyboard pass: activeElement sequence + slider 0.50->0.51 with readout update

summary: Edge/failure angle. Chromium 141 run: all seven probes honestly report 'no' with the 0/7 summary explicitly framing rejection as the pre-144 result; the CSS Color 4 matrix math (sRGB→XYZ→linear-P3) outputs labelled JS values with the browser cross-check marked unavailable; the @supports card computed color(display-p3 0.24 0.53 0.94) and correctly reported the gamma-encoded fallback branch won.
